bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years via int(float(years)), causing undeclared behavior and precision/overflow risk for large inputs
compound_interest does not validate principal is non-negative/finite
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months with int(months) instead of rejecting invalid terms
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float or hostile numeric types can raise TypeError or trigger inconsistent arithmetic unlike other money functions
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure during account_to balance addition can leave funds removed
transfer does not validate account balances/currencies/amount are finite Decimals, allowing NaN/Infinity or malformed account state to leak into money operations
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction amount
apply_fee does not validate fee_pct/fee bounds are finite Decimals
fx_convert does not validate FX rate is positive and finite, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates to create invalid conversions
